rows.label: tlk70000004_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Heard Felt Village's been
attacked. A similar thing
happened in Estham not so long ago.

rows.label: tlk70000004_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Thought that kind of trouble only
ever happened abroad... World's
more dangerous these days.

rows.label: tlk70000004_01_msg0003
rows.name:
But we should be safe here in
the capital, so long as the
king's noble reign continues.

rows.label: tlk70000004_01_msg0004
rows.name:
What we need isn't preparation against
villains. We must stay calm and keep
our usual way of life.
